title: Local MP4 seeking repair
details: MP4 evidence is now converted to fast-start structure locally so the video timeline can seek without relying on Dropbox or another streaming service
The MP4 index is moved before the video data and all chunk offsets are corrected without re-encoding
Existing stored MP4 observations are repaired when Milos opens or exports the media, so previous evidence can be used without recording it again
New MP4 recordings are repaired before they are stored on the device
AC start and end timestamps remain shown on the evidence PDF and now correspond to positions that can be reached directly in the video
